messages:
alex_sales: EdgeWave RFP landed — they want a capability matrix (feature + security + ops), PoC timeline, and answers for KMS/HSM, data residency, and peering. PDF: https://edgewave.example/rfp/edgewave-rfp.pdf. Need consolidated responses by EOD Fri. cc @maria_solution_eng @ben_platform @liz_legal :eyes:

maria_solution_eng: Got it. Do we want a simple 1-5 scoring for each capability (1=missing, 5=fully supported) or a pass/fail + notes? 1-5 is easier to compare across vendors.

ben_platform: 1-5 sounds good. For PoC, recommend 3 weeks: week1 infra & smoke, week2 perf & tuning, week3 acceptance tests + handover. Acceptance: throughput >= 2k tokens/sec sustained, 99th perc latency < 300ms, deterministic rollout.

liz_legal: Would need to confirm NDA status before sharing internal PoC configs. Also: they asked about HSM-backed keywrap for embeddings — we can say we support KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure) and an on-prem HSM option via our Private deployment. Need product to confirm exact wording for RFP.

alex_sales: Draft capability matrix snippet below — please edit scores and add short notes. I'll attach final CSV in the RFP bundle. Also pricing bands: Hosted tier: $0.0009/Token gen, Dedicated: committed monthly + overage, Private: license + support. We can offer 10% PoC credit for a 3-week trial.

```csv
feature,redwood_score,notes
model_catalog,5,"curated open + verified perf"
streaming,5,"server-side chunked streaming + sdk"
private_deploy,5,"VPC + onprem package + KMS/HSM support"
batching_controls,4,"auto batching + manual overrides"
quant_profiles,4,"recommendations + tested q8/q4 ops"
```

maria_solution_eng: Quick question on the scoring: for `quant_profiles` do we want to call out which quant bits were validated and on which GPUs? EdgeWave specifically asked about A100 vs H100 perf. Suggest a short note: "A100 validated q8; H100 validation in progress".

ben_platform: For PoC infra proposal: suggest dedicated pool sized as 4xA100-80GB equivalent for the duration. Config snippet for EdgeWave ops team to spin up (they asked for an ops example):

```yaml
poс_environment:
  type: dedicated
  nodes: 4
  gpu: a100-80gb
  autoscale: false
  image: redwood-runtime:2026-02
  networking:
    peering: yes
    allowed_ips: ["10.0.0.0/16"]
```

alex_sales: Nice. @liz_legal — can we put "HSM option available via on-prem Private offering, requires enterprise license and SOW" for the RFP? If yes, I'll include that line.

liz_legal: Yes that's fine. Add: "Customer-managed HSM integration via PKCS#11 or KMIP supported; requires field eng assist during integration and separate HSM SLA."

deploy-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.internal/docs/sales/edgewave-rfp-bundle (private). Attachment: edgewave_capability_matrix.csv

maria_solution_eng: I'll run the perf checklist and fill in the perf row with A100 numbers by tomorrow AM. Also adding a short test plan for their acceptance criteria.

ben_platform: Who will own the PoC ops during the trial? I can be primary on infra and monitoring if @maria_solution_eng covers validation tests.

alex_sales: That works. I'll own pricing and commercial terms + coordinate signature of NDA. Next steps: maria fills perf numbers, ben finalizes infra snippet, liz adds final legal wording, I assemble and send bundle by EOD Fri. Thanks :pray:
